unverified_statements.reason: The spec asks for the profile before any build of REQ-007, REQ-008 or REQ-011. The pack therefore says only that the mapping is built on the assumed grain.

unverified_statements.text: Whether MIG-0007's up script applies the 12-row seed of silv_ref_invoice_line_type, or the seed script is run as a separate step.

unverified_statements.text: How, and by whom, unmapped item codes are mapped by hand in production (process, access rights, owner).
unverified_statements.reason: The artefacts say only that codes 'must be mapped by hand' and that 'a person' changes the line type. MOD-005 grants no access to the table, so who is allowed to update it is not recorded.
